name: Marksans Pharma Ltd
title: Marksans Pharma Ltd - 524404 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 record quarter (revenue INR856 cr, EBITDA margin 22.8%) with petroleum-linked raw material inflation of 20-30% partly buffered by 5-6 months inventory; FY27 margin guided flat at 20-21%, growth 15-20%.

utilisation.quote: You can say, like I said, around 50% to 55%.

capex.quote: We are planning some capex, but within the facility because it's huge.

triggers.label: 5-6 months RM inventory cover
triggers.quote: we sit on a good 5 to 6 months of inventory at all given time

guidance.quote: No, I think it will be the same.
INR4,000 crores within the next 2 years is very much on the plate right now.
within the next 3 years, we should hit tho se objectives of hitting our first milestone of $100 million

prior_guidance_check.quote: During the year, we crossed INR3,000 crores in net income for the first time

red_flags.label: Working capital at 138 days, rising YoY
red_flags.quote: Our working capital remained at 138 days.

red_flags.label: Raw material inflation 20-30% with contracts not repriced
red_flags.quote: we would like to wait and watch because if tomorrow, things do correct

I'm more optimistic that, yes, 2027 will see some M&A transactions happening.
